quotes.text: D323799 is a single-commit static in-flow Calendar dialog-shell sizing slice, not production opener/routing/data behavior. Its wrapper contract requires `position: relative` and `block-size: 100%`; the `absolute`/`max-block-size: 100%` experiment broke the submitted sizing model and was removed. The final patch passed focused normal and enabled-a11y tests (35/35 each), paired fast build, ESLint, raw-diff checks, and CodeRabbit (0 findings). [Task 5]
